text: Burning for Pallas.

lines: Nav: trajectory nominal, drift within tolerance.
Ice hauler "Mule's Promise", all ships: we're short a coolant pump. Will pay at Ceres.
Arcology Pact Navy picket: routine sweep, no contacts.
Someone is playing music on the emergency band again. The picket tells them to clear it.
Crash couch: anti-g drip reservoir at 80 percent.
"...so they docked us the day, and the shift still had to be made up." The rest is static.
Automated beacon: Ceres Station reports all docking bays open. Water ration unchanged.
Courier "Swift Dispatch": running a hard burn, requesting the approach clear.
Life support: CO2 scrubbers cycling.
A voice with no transponder behind it: "Plume off the port side, running dark. Anyone else have it?"
Dome Pact Navy: all vessels, maintain transponders in Martian space.
Static on a Belt band, a few words in a language nobody aboard speaks, then static again.
Reactor: output steady. Drive plume stable.
Freighter "Second Wind", to the band: "Forty days out. If anyone has the Orbitals match, we'll trade for it."
An old recorded voice on a lane beacon: "This lane is maintained by the Ceres Water Authority. Lane fees are payable at any Authority office."
Hauler "Long Odds": "Spare berth to Titan. Two hundred a day, and you cook."
Arcology Pact traffic control: lane fees fall due on the first. Ships in arrears will be held at the next Pact port.
A child on an open band, reading out a ship's call sign and asking if anyone can hear. A woman comes on and takes the handset back.
Ceres Water Authority relay: the ration at Ceres goes down a litre a head from the first. Ships calling are asked to bring their own.
Belt trader on the band: "Onions, a crate at the flip, Ceres prices. Bring your own bags."
Tug "Old Bess": "Anyone know a clinic at Ganymede that takes Guild cover? My knee's gone."
Static, then someone singing a few lines of an old work song on an open channel, until they key off.
Mars traffic: all ships in the Phobos approach corridor, hold your slot. The corridor is running two hours behind.
Someone on the emergency band: "Testing. Is this on?" The picket says it is, and to get off it.
Drive: injector four reading warm. Within limits.
A distant hauler is reading a recipe for fried dough over an open channel, for someone on another ship.
Luna control: Copernicus berths are full until the fourteenth. Inbound ships will be given a slot at Tycho.
Ring-ball commentary, faint, from a ship somewhere behind: the Orbitals are two down at the half.
Nav: micrometeoroid flux low. Hull integrity nominal.
A salvager on the band: "Boots, suit liners, a crate of filters, all off a hull we broke up at Juno. Make an offer."
Enceladus relay: geyser activity is up today. All ships keep clear of the plume.
A young voice on an open channel asks which planet has the ring. Somebody tells them it's Saturn.
The hull ticks as it cools in the shadow.
A hauler crew sings "Happy Birthday" on the open band, for a captain who doesn't answer.
Eros beacon: the Old Town's far half is closed. Ships for the Old Town dock at the near lock.
Galley: the coffee's out until Ceres. Somebody has put it on the stores list twice.
A Ceres station on a low band, reading the names of the haulers lost on the ice this year, one at a time.
